answers:
It looks like you are passing the token incorrectly in Postman when you select Bearer Token from the authorization tab as type. You don't have to add Bearer before your token in this case, that is why your token is getting mismatched. Check the below screenshot of how the string Bearer is getting prepended twicce to your access token.


Instead, you just need to add the access token to the value which should solve the issue.

nuggets.text: The "Unauthenticated" error is caused by incorrect token handling in Postman.

When using Postman's Bearer Token authorization type, only the access token should be entered without manually adding the "Bearer" prefix.
